beats.vo: Hello again, champ! Welcome back to Mentr Learn. Nice to see you.
beats.caption: Hello again, champ!

beats.vo: Yesterday we learned what a computer is. Today we go one step deeper.
beats.caption: Building on Chapter 1

beats.vo: This is Chapter two. The lesson is: How Computers Understand Us.
beats.caption: Chapter 2 · How Computers Understand Us

beats.vo: Say it with me… How… Computers… Understand… Us.
beats.caption: Say with me: How Computers Understand Us

beats.vo: Brilliant. Let's open the secret of computers.
beats.caption: Let's open the secret!

beats.vo: Here is a puzzle. Computers are clever… but they do not speak Hindi or English like we do.
beats.caption: Computers don't speak like us…

beats.vo: So how do they understand games, photos, and messages?
beats.caption: How do they understand us?

beats.vo: Pause. Guess for three seconds… how does a computer talk inside?
beats.caption: ⏸ Your turn — make a guess!

beats.vo: Keep your guess. We will prove it with light switches.
beats.caption: We'll prove it with switches

beats.vo: The big idea is tiny and powerful. Inside a computer, everything is only two states.
beats.caption: Big idea: only TWO states

beats.vo: Like a light switch — ON… or OFF. That is all.
beats.caption: Like a light switch: ON or OFF

beats.vo: Say with me: On… or off. Only two choices!
beats.caption: Say: On… or off!

beats.vo: We write ON as the number one. We write OFF as the number zero.
beats.caption: ON = 1 · OFF = 0

beats.vo: One means on. Zero means off. Easy!
beats.caption: 1 = on · 0 = off · Easy!

beats.vo: Now imagine three light switches in a row. Left, middle, right.
beats.caption: Three switches in a row

beats.vo: Each switch can be on or off. So each switch is a one or a zero.
beats.caption: Each switch = 1 or 0

beats.vo: Look: switch off, off, on — we write zero, zero, one.
beats.caption: off off on → 0 0 1

beats.vo: Or on, off, on — we write one, zero, one.
beats.caption: on off on → 1 0 1

beats.vo: That pattern of ones and zeros is called binary. Bi means two. Two choices only.
beats.caption: Binary = language of TWO

beats.vo: You do not need hard maths today. Just remember: binary is the computer's light-switch language.
beats.caption: Binary = light-switch language

beats.vo: Your turn to read! I show a pattern. You say the zeros and ones out loud.
beats.caption: Your turn — read the lights!

beats.vo: Pattern one: off, off, on. You say… zero, zero, one!
beats.caption: Pattern 1: 0 0 1

beats.vo: Pattern two: on, on, off. You say… one, one, zero!
beats.caption: Pattern 2: 1 1 0

beats.vo: Pattern three: on, off, on. You say… one, zero, one!
beats.caption: Pattern 3: 1 0 1

beats.vo: Super reading. That is how computers store tiny bits of information.
beats.caption: Super! Tiny bits of information

beats.vo: Practice check — same kind of question you will see later.
beats.caption: Practice check

beats.vo: If one means on, what does one-zero-one mean on three lights?
beats.caption: What does 1 0 1 mean?

beats.vo: Think… left on, middle off, right on.
beats.caption: Think: left · middle · right

beats.vo: Yes! One-zero-one means on, off, on. Three lights telling a tiny story.
beats.caption: Answer: ON · OFF · ON ✓

beats.vo: Why learn this? Because every photo, every game, every message becomes ones and zeros inside.
beats.caption: Photos, games, messages → 0s & 1s

beats.vo: Your brain uses words. The computer uses on and off — then turns it back into pictures and sound for you.
beats.caption: Words ↔ on/off ↔ pictures & sound

beats.vo: So when someone says binary, you can smile and say: light-switch language!
beats.caption: Binary = light-switch language!

beats.vo: Lock it in. Computers understand on and off. On is one. Off is zero.
beats.caption: ON = 1 · OFF = 0

beats.vo: A row of ones and zeros is binary — the computer's special language.
beats.caption: Binary = the computer's language

beats.vo: You can read a short pattern like one-zero-one as on, off, on.
beats.caption: 101 → on, off, on

beats.vo: Chapter two done. How Computers Understand Us — excellent work today!
beats.caption: Chapter 2 complete!
